The '''GAT-12g "Skipray"''' was part of the [[GAT Blastboat series]] produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

==Characteristics==
The GAT-12g "Skipray" was a sub-model of the twenty-five [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]]. The GAT-12g replaced the usual missile launcher with a tractor beam.<ref name="PP" />

==History==
The GAT-12g was used by Imperial forces.<ref name="PP" />
